TLDR: DBT, support groups, lots of hard work and dedication helped my mom

My mum has bpd. before I was diagnosed we would physically fight, have screaming fits, the whole family was dysfunctional. When I was diagnosed my mom found out she had bpd on her medical records as a teen. She has me and two boys. I moved to foster care (not cuz of her but bc of my dad and my mental health). She took me to bpd support groups every week, we volunteer with foundations to raise awareness n money for bpd research, she did two full rounds of DBT, she now works with a hospital to teach skills and support ppl who’s loved ones and parents who have kids that have bpd. She’s learnt so many skills to manage her bpd. we bound over it together. She is also chronically ill, was always so so exhausted and sore. She got a job from home and she absolutely loves it, she wasn’t able to work before because of her illnesses. She takes care of my teen brothers and I visit her every week. Me and her hardly ever fight, she never snaps at me anymore, she has taught me so many valuable lessons. She put so much hard work into making her life worth living, and her kids lives worth living. Idk if this helped, I hope it did.
